description: ORVYX is a six-member team making space data accessible to everyone. For NASA Space Apps 2026, we're developing a web-based explorer for Planet X and SPHEREx. Users will search sky coordinates, compare infrared observations over time, and spot moving or changing celestial objects through interactive time-lapses. Our interests include astrophysics, software engineering, data analysis, AI, and visualization. We welcome builders and researchers who want to turn observations into discoveries.
